name: think-first
description: Makes Claude run a sequential-thinking step before its first write in each turn, and again before retrying a tool call that just failed. Installs the Model Context Protocol sequential-thinking server it relies on, pinned to one version.

writes.title: Writes
writes.description: Which tools count as writes, as patterns separated by semicolons. A plain pattern is a glob (* matches anything); /regex/ matches anywhere in the tool name. Default matches MCP tools whose names create, update, delete, send, publish and similar.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Which tools need a thinking step before they are retried after a failure, in the same pattern format. Default is every MCP tool.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce blocks the call; warn lets it run and tells Claude it skipped the thinking step
